mapper.sql: payments.id, payments.public_id AS publicId, payments.table_session_id AS tableSessionId, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, payments.amount, payments.bill_snapshot AS billSnapshot, payments.status, payments.confirmed_by_name AS confirmedByName, payments.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payments INNER JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.id=payments.table_session_id INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=table_sessions.table_id WHERE payments.table_session_id=#{sessionId}

SELECT FROM payments INNER JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.id=payments.table_session_id INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=table_sessions.table_id WHERE dining_tables.store_id=#{storeId} AND payments.public_id=#{publicId}

SELECT FROM payments INNER JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.id=payments.table_session_id INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=table_sessions.table_id WHERE dining_tables.store_id=#{storeId} AND payments.status='PENDING' ORDER BY payments.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET status='PAID',confirmed_by=#{accountId},confirmed_by_name=#{name},confirmed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE unpaid_records SET status='RESOLVED',resolution_payment_id=#{paymentId},resolved_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE table_session_id=#{sessionId} AND status='OPEN'
